Testing gyrA (0.466 posterior) starts incubation in parallel while leaving ample time to publish Ticket 2 next.

Test top candidate araC (0.545) now so it incubates while we immediately publish expiring Ticket 3 next.

E9 splits the Ticket 6 prior nearly evenly (0.555 vs 0.445), maximizing information gain with limited round time remaining.

With 7 seconds left in the round, no experiment can finish; publishing recA at 0.608 posterior maximizes expected final score.
